name: Central
beschreibung:
Located in the heart of Innsbruck, the historic Hotel Central provides sophisticated living comfort, fine dining, and an extensive wellness area. The charming old town, featuring the Golden Roof and imperial landmarks, is just a short walk away.

Direct connection to the Nordkette cable car allows guests to seamlessly merge vibrant city culture with alpine mountain adventures in the Karwendel range.
kurzbeschreibung: The traditional Hotel Central in Innsbruck combines urban comfort, wellness, and alpine scenery in the heart of Tyrol's capital.
